recipe.visualDefinition: A centered studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s hair, wearing a red and white polka dot dress that blends into a matching polka dot background, topped with a black header bar featuring vibrant red and white script.
coreVisualRelationships: Black header bar as a structural anchor
High-contrast red and white dominance against black
Organic script vs. geometric dot grid
coreInvariants: Uniform polka dot size and spacing
Flat black header bar at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, waist-up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black horizontal bar at the top provides a heavy visual weight to ground the light pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast header text, move down to the subject's face, and follow the pattern down the dress.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The polka dot background acts as active negative space, creating a vibrating optical effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure White (background base, dress dots, belt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red and high value white create a high-key, energetic feel.
paletteRestrictions: Natural skin tones and hair browns

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a horizontal lean
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters are enlarged versions of lowercase forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text to maintain a personal, signature-like feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the personal, handwritten look of the original.
Captures the era's specific typographic trends.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with 80s-style voluminous hair, wearing a red and white polka dot dress. The background should be a matching red and white polka dot pattern. Add a solid black horizontal bar at the very top of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-lettered monoline script text in white and red inside the black header bar. Ensure the text is horizontally extended and centered.

verificationChecks: Is the polka dot pattern consistent between the dress and background?
Is the header bar solid black and perfectly horizontal?
Does the text have a monolinear, handwritten appearance?
Is the color palette limited to red, white, black, and natural skin/hair tones?

adjustableVariables: Text color distribution (all white vs. mixed red/white)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for pattern alignment at the subject's edges
Verify text legibility against the black background
Ensure the red is vibrant and not orange-leaning
Confirm the 80s hair style is accurately represented
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Polka Dot Camouflage + Black Header Bar + Monoline Script
